ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity (off-white central regions) to 35% low-intensity (black perimeters and heavy internal scarring).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity zones centered in both lobes; low-intensity pixels form a continuous thick border along the trailing and leading edges, with extensive linear low-intensity streaks (rake marks) intersecting the high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 50 degrees with a localized pixel depth reaching the vertical center of the fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serration pattern; peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the distal thirds of both lobes, appearing as a jagged linear boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to an upward-swept, tapered distal tip on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular nodes (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme distal tips; approximately 5-7 distinct white-on-black clusters on the right tip and 4-6 on the left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark linear rake marks; primary features include a set of parallel diagonal abrasions on the right lobe and multiple intersecting vertical scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations on the distal tips and heavy rake mark scarring (likely orca-induced) across the majority of the visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical fanned pigmentation pattern consisting of dark streaks originating from the peduncle insertion point and radiating upward towards the median notch.
